subject: Mutual-success charter: 6-week evaluation kickoff for Solstice Health
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Claire Donahue <claire.donahue@solsticehealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 03 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual-success charter: 6-week evaluation kickoff for Solstice Health

Hi Claire —

Great to connect last week. As promised, I wanted to kick off a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) so we have a clear 6-week evaluation runway and owner list. Attached is a lightweight MAP template and a proposed timeline PDF to get us started. High-level goals I heard from our call:

- Validate Redwood inference latency and cost targets on your q2 workloads (p95 < 250ms for 2k seq).
- Confirm integration points for prefix caching and KV reuse in your pipeline.
- Run a 30-day quality assessment against your eval set and compare throughput/cost tradeoffs.

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) Agree on stakeholders and a kickoff meeting (30–45m) — I suggest next Tue/Wed morning PT.
2) Share any security/compliance contacts (SOC2 evidence owner) so we can include them in week 1.
3) Confirm procurement timeline and any SOW constraints.

I’ve tentatively suggested a kickoff on Tue, Sep 8 at 10:00 AM PT — happy to move. I’ve CC’d Aditya to help with scheduling and to capture notes.

Attachments: MAP_foundation_template_v1.xlsx; 6-week-eval-timeline.pdf

Thanks, and excited to get this rolling.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com | (415) 555-0198
https://redwood.com

--
Note: If you prefer a shorter checklist-style MAP instead of the spreadsheet, I can convert this into a Google Doc and share a live link for collaboration.
From: Claire Donahue <claire.donahue@solsticehealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 03 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual-success charter: 6-week evaluation kickoff for Solstice Health

Thanks Neha — this looks good and appreciates the structure.

Quick answers:
- Champion: me (Product Manager, Solstice Health).
- Stakeholders to loop: Dr. Ellen Ruiz (exec sponsor, cc’d on this thread), Raj Patel (procurement), and our infra lead Kevin Morris (kevin.morris@solsticehealth.com).
- Security contact: Priya Shah (security@solsticehealth.com) — please include for any evidence requests.
- Procurement: Raj wants a line-item estimate + approximate SOW; timeline target is to finish procurement approvals within 4 weeks of pilot acceptance.

I’m available Tue Sep 8 at 10:00 AM PT. If you can include a short agenda for the kickoff (objectives, owners, deliverables + week-by-week checkpoints), that would be perfect. Also can you call out any non-starter requirements from Redwood’s side? e.g., minimum token retention, allowed regions, KMS options.

Looking forward to the MAP draft in Google Doc form so the team can comment live.

Claire
Claire Donahue
Senior Product Manager, Solstice Health
claire.donahue@solsticehealth.com | (617) 555-7241

Thanks Claire — great, calendar invite sent for Tue Sep 8, 10:00 AM PT (30m). Agenda preview:

1) Introductions & success criteria (5m)
2) Walk through MAP template and deliverables (10m)
3) Security & procurement expectations (5m)
4) Owners, timelines, and immediate blockers (10m)

Marissa — I’ve looped you in as our CS lead so you can confirm who from onboarding will own the week 1 technical setup. Marissa, if you prefer, I can move the kickoff to 45m — let me know.

Claire — a few non-starter items to flag up front from Redwood:
- We need a security contact (we’ll only request SOC2 artifacts via secure upload).
- For the pilot we recommend a single-region deployment (us-west-2) to keep latency stable; if you need eu data residency we can scope that.
- We generally ask for a 30-day eval data retention window for logs; if you need longer please flag now.

I’ll convert the MAP spreadsheet into a shared Google Doc and drop the link into the invite so your team can comment live.

Attachments: (converted) link will be in event

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
